paragraphs.text: Please include removal of the redundant pump plinth. We need a usable floor afterward, but I do not know what is beneath the cover.
Cover could not be opened during the visit. The visible rim could be either a shallow housekeeping pad or the top of a deeper foundation. Removal depth and reinstatement limit remain unknown.
The caretaker remembers a drain nearby; this is recollection, not a verified service location.
I can arrange access next week. No depth has been approved; keep this question open until the inspection. The pump was removed under another order.
Remove the redundant plinth and make good the floor; depth and reinstatement extent to be confirmed before final pricing.
